$comment: Ground truth captured from the real game. If a fixture fails, the engine is wrong, not the fixture. Entries with pending_verification true carry documented behaviour rather than an observed reading, and are reported as unconfirmed until the flag is cleared.

fixtures.description: One 95 plus ten 84s. The only case that discriminates floor from round in step 5 of the squad rating formula. SUM 935, AR 85.0, CF 10.0, T 945, 945/11 = 85.909. floor gives 85, round gives 86. None of the four test vectors in the brief reach past the .5 boundary, so without this fixture that step is untested.
fixtures.source: PENDING. To be built as a Concept Squad in the web app, no card ownership needed. Expected value 85 is the documented floor behaviour, not an observed reading. If the game shows 86, step 5 of section 4.1 becomes round and this expected value changes to 86.
